prompt_en: Create a dark luxury heraldic emblem featuring a royal cobra centered on a wide horizontal canvas. The cobra faces forward with its hood fully spread, coiled body at the bottom, glossy black scales edged in reflective metallic gold, a golden segmented belly, intense glowing eyes, and a black forked tongue. Place exactly 1 ornate gold crown on the cobra's head and exactly 1 small black-and-gold shield crest below the neck, showing a tiny crowned cobra symbol. Use a black, metallic gold, and deep bronze palette with high contrast, polished 3D metal rendering, dramatic rim lighting, sparkling gold dust accents, and a dark textured damask background. title: Candid 商城购物快照
author: Dgv Fhc
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,群像 / 情侣,产品
prompt_en: Create a realistic low-resolution candid phone photo of two young adults descending an indoor shopping mall escalator, captured from a lower diagonal angle across the escalator. The composition should feel accidental and slightly imperfect, with the escalator handrail and glass side panel cutting across the foreground as a strong diagonal obstruction. On the left, show a cheerful young man with short black slightly tousled hair, wearing a dark casual short-sleeve shirt. He is smiling genuinely while carrying several oversized PC hardware boxes pressed against his torso, including visible GeForce RTX 4080 graphics card boxes, ASUS or GALAX-style GPU packaging, and a large black AORUS monitor box. His face, neck, forearms, and hands are visible, with natural warm skin tone and practical tension in the hands from holding heavy boxes. On the right, show a slim young woman standing slightly higher on the escalator, calm and composed, looking downward rather than at the camera. She has a neat short dark bob haircut with straight bangs, soft indoor shine, pale warm ivory skin, and an East Asian fashion-editorial inspired makeup style: smooth matte base, subtle eyes, and defined red lips. She wears a fitted sleeveless cream or beige knit top covered with small repeated dark text-like pattern, matching long patterned arm sleeves, and a short black pleated skirt with vivid blue and turquoise plaid paneling, blue trim, and a dark belt. Visible skin includes her face, neck, exposed shoulders, upper arms, a small neckline area, and partially visible thighs above the escalator rail. The skin should look natural and softly matte, as if smooth and cool to the touch, lit by ordinary overhead mall lights rather than beauty lighting. The background is a warm brown wood or laminate wall panel area inside a mall or electronics shopping center, with vertical seams, reflective metal rails, glass panels, and a partial passerby shape near the edge of the frame. Use practical indoor mall lighting: soft overhead illumination, warm reflected light from the brown wall, weak uneven shadows, and broken reflections on the escalator glass and metal. Keep a deep phone-camera-like depth of field where the subjects, boxes, escalator, and background remain mostly readable. The image should preserve compressed social-media photo texture: mild noise, softened details, slightly muddy colors, imperfect framing, and a believable candid snapshot feeling. The emotional tone is a funny, slightly surreal tech purchase moment: the man looks proud and happy after buying expensive gaming hardware, while the woman appears cool, stylish, and detached. It should feel like they had just bought the hardware and were caught by someone passing by before either noticed the camera.\

categories: 产品营销,摄影,电影感 / 电影剧照,交通工具
prompt_en: Create a cinematic two-panel automotive action photograph in a 16:9 horizontal frame, split exactly down the center by a thin vertical black divider. Left panel: an interior cockpit shot from the passenger side of a classic compact sports car, showing one driver wearing a black racing jacket with two white sleeve stripes, black leather driving gloves, a black harness, and a small gold hoop earring. The driver has messy dark hair, their face intentionally obscured by a plain dark brown square, hands gripping the steering wheel, seated in a black RECARO-style bucket seat. The cabin is dark, tight, and realistic, with blurred forest and guardrail streaking past the window to imply speed. Right panel: a dynamic rear three-quarter tracking shot of a white Toyota MR2 AW11 late-model G-Limited Supercharger driving fast on a winding Japanese mountain road. Show the car from low behind, centered slightly right, with rectangular red taillights, black rear trim, rear spoiler, rear glass engine cover area, visible badge text including “TOYOTA MR2” and “SUPER CHARGER,” and a Japanese license plate reading 20-00. The road curves through dense green forest with metal guardrails, stone retaining walls, orange center lines, and strong motion blur on the asphalt. Use photorealistic DSLR quality, natural overcast daylight, muted green and gray tones, high shutter-speed realism mixed with panning blur, dramatic touge racing atmosphere, and no extra captions, logos, watermarks, or added vehicles.\

Small body text should not look like independent labels but be compressed into compact informational textures embedded in the gaps around the subject, maintaining short line spacing, restrained colors, and an editorial feel. Details of the subject are concentrated only in positions that best convey tactile sensation and theme identity, while other secondary edges are allowed to be cropped, blocked, or slightly softened to maintain hierarchy. The final surface has a vintage print passivation, with slightly soft text edges, ink deposition in color blocks, and paper texture running through all layers without blurring subject details, overall presenting a hybrid of a carefully typographed editorial poster, packaging layout, and specimen description.

title: 孟买雨街摄影
author: Harboris
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,电影感 / 电影剧照,肖像 / 自拍,城市景观 / 街景
prompt_en:
Ultra-realistic cinematic street photography of a young man standing alone on a rainy urban sidewalk during golden hour sunset in Mumbai, India. He is leaning casually against a black metal roadside railing while looking down at his smartphone, wearing an oversized black hoodie, loose dark blue cargo jeans, and clean white sneakers. Messy textured black hair moving slightly in the wind. Moody introspective vibe.

Wide-angle composition with dramatic depth and strong leading lines from the wet pavement and railings. Reflective rain-soaked street surface glowing with warm sunset light. Vintage street lamps lining the sidewalk. Historic Gothic architecture inspired by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus visible on the right side, detailed stone textures and clock tower. Modern skyscrapers fading into atmospheric haze in the distant background, creating a blend of old and new Mumbai cityscape.

Soft cinematic clouds filling the sky with warm orange, peach, and golden tones. A flying bird silhouette crossing the sky. Light traffic with black-and-yellow taxis and blurred cars moving through the street. Realistic puddle reflections, subtle motion blur, volumetric lighting, atmospheric perspective, ultra-detailed textures, natural shadows, realistic skin tones.

Shot on Sony A7R IV, 35mm lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, HDR photography, photorealistic, cinematic color grading, warm highlights with cool shadows, highly detailed urban realism, editorial photography style, 8K ultra resolution.\

prompt_en: Generate a minimalist flat illustration with a ceremonial greeting feel based on the theme of college entrance exam success. The top of the frame retains a large area of white space for breathing room, with a small-font signature and subtle seal marks in the upper left corner. The middle section uses a small amount of handwritten blessings or slogans as an emotional pivot. The lower section features a main information area resembling a combination of a printed stamp and a ticket border, with uneven line thickness and hand-pressed deckled edges. Inside this area, a large, coarse, textured thematic character or symbol is spread as a background, partially obscured by the central symbolic object. The central object is rendered with clean lines and flat color blocks, standing upright and stable as the focal point of blessing. Small icons, short inscriptions, and circular seals are arranged around it, unfolding layers of information like marks on a handmade gift note. Colors are extracted from the theme's cultural signals: high-brightness, clean backgrounds, with clear accent colors for structural lines and characters. The mood is bright, clean, solemn, and intimate, with textures of fine paper fiber and slight misregistration, avoiding heavy aging or dirt.\

prompt_en: A candid photo-dump collage designed to feel like [HUMAN]'s phone gallery from one rainy afternoon running errands downtown. [HUMAN] wears a damp charcoal-grey oversized trench coat layered over a cream ribbed turtleneck, faded black straight-leg jeans and worn white leather sneakers. The mechanic is a six-panel grid stitched together like an iPhone camera roll, each photo slightly water-speckled on the lens with soft flash hotspots bouncing off wet pavement. Panels: a blurry mirror shot in a shop's rain-fogged window, an overhead shot of shoes splashing through a puddle at a crosswalk, a low-angle shot from a bus shelter bench looking up mid-laugh, a fisheye selfie under an umbrella inches from the lens, a candid shot reflected in a coffee cup lid on a café table, and a motion-blurred shot taken mid-stride on an escalator. Expressions shift from a squinting laugh in the rain to a skeptical side-eye at a shop window to a quiet, unposed half-smile on the bus. Cohesive charcoal grey, cream, faded black and wet-pavement silver palette. Premium candid lifestyle photography, visible grain and uneven exposure, no glossy textures, aspect ratio 4:5.\

English text uses high-contrast or narrow serif fonts, scattered as subtle annotations. Hierarchy must be clear, with one main title and other short phrases arranged sparsely like specimen labels. The color palette maintains a clean paper feel with a warm white background and black for structure, accented by small, precisely placed bright soft colors derived from the theme.
